text: Foster carer here, 4 year old girl in my care. Temperature 40°C, taken twice in the last half hour with the ear thermometer, same both times. She's had a mild cough since yesterday, nothing heavy, just a little tickly one now and then. Before anyone asks, I've checked her over properly, back, chest, arms, legs, feet, and there is no rash anywhere. No spots, no marks, nothing. I've looked twice. So that's the cough and the high temperature and that's it. I've done this long enough to know a 40 needs flagging, but I don't need a long list of maybes. I need to know whether she needs to be seen tonight or whether I keep an eye on her at home and ring back if anything changes. A straight answer would be appreciated.
